name: Honda - Performance Manufacturing Center (PMC) - Marysville OH

fieldNotes.location: PMC confirmed - roster geocode moved only 26 m. Satellite shows a single dark-roof main building with a white-roof east annex; a user-contributed Street View interior photo shows the NSX assembly floor, positively identifying the Performance Manufacturing Center.
fieldNotes.scale_of_facility: PMC is a small low-volume specialty plant (~184,000 sq ft, ~100 associates) housed in Honda's former North American Logistics facility (per hondanews / Gardner Web). Modest yard footprint compared to the big assembly plants.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Driveway from Honda Parkway runs to the building's east-side yard. No barrier arm or guard booth resolvable in z19-z21 imagery; the entrance reads as an open driveway. Set false (truckGate) with low confidence - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth identified at the entrance; false.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock bank on the building's east face - roughly 6-9 doors with several trailers backed in (former logistics building retains dock infrastructure). 0-10 band; count is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Small paved yard on the east side holds a handful of parked trailers - 0-10.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long approach drive from Honda Parkway into the building yard - can hold 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main plant building plus an attached white-roof east annex.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Open farmland setting on the Marysville complex outskirts - Rural.
